name: CloudBees CodeShip API
tagline: REST API for CloudBees CodeShip CI project and build management
description: CloudBees CodeShip provides a REST API for managing CI projects, builds, deployments, and team resources on CodeShip Basic and Pro. Developers authenticate to obtain a short-lived token, then call versioned endpoints under api.codeship.com to list projects, trigger builds, inspect build status, and automate pipeline workflows for teams still on CodeShip.

auth.details: POST /auth with HTTP Basic (email:password) returns a short-lived access_token; send as Authorization: Bearer <token> on subsequent requests. Token expires (typically ~1 hour).

pricing.free_tier_limits: unknown — API access tied to CodeShip product plan; free API quota not separately published
pricing.paid_plans: CodeShip Basic and Pro subscription plans; API included with product access

use_cases: authenticate and list CodeShip organizations for a user
list CI projects in an organization
trigger a new build for a project
get build status and details for a pipeline
list recent builds for a project
